title: Disc sets up polycythemia vera challenge but Silence maintains lead
snippet: The polycythemia vera field is heating up, with Disc Medicine and Silence Therapeutics each advancing next-generation therapies, playing catch-up to Takeda and Protagonist Therapeutics, who won the FDA’s approval last month for Mimrylo.

title: Frazier adds $1.1B+ to small and mid-sized biotech fund
snippet: Frazier’s life science fund has already benefited several successful biotechs, including Verona Pharma, which was acquired by Merck for $10 billion, and Carmot Therapeutics, which Roche bought for $2.7 billion.

title: Novartis drags peers down with triple asset stumble
snippet: Novartis’ shares fell 13% this week after the report of three separate late-stage asset setbacks. The impact went beyond the Swiss drugmaker, dragging peers down across the market.

title: Mikhail, Davis embody the FDA’s stabilization, Seehafer signals AI revolution is coming
snippet: Newly solidified in their roles as the heads of CBER and CDER, Karim Mikahil and Michael Davis have been working for months to right the ship that had begun to capsize under former Commissioner Marty Makary. Meanwhile, Jared Seehafer will become the first-ever deputy commissioner focused on artificial intelligence.

title: Novartis’ board faces investor scrutiny after M&A misfires and R&D flops
snippet: Back-to-back failures of multiple late-phase trials have raised questions about how Novartis has deployed capital in pursuit of drugs to drive growth through the 2030s.
